{"code": "import chess, time
board=chess.Board('rnb1kbnr/ppp2ppp/8/4N3/3qp3/2N5/PPPP1PPP/R1BQKB1R w KQkq - 2 5')
VAL={'P':100,'N':320,'B':330,'R':500,'Q':900,'K':0}
# simpler but sensible PST: use only knight/bishop center and pawn advancement
def white_eval(b):
    if b.is_checkmate(): return -100000 if b.turn else 100000
    if b.is_stalemate() or b.is_insufficient_material(): return 0
    s=0
    for sq,p in b.piece_map().items():
        v=VAL[p.symbol().upper()]
        f=chess.square_file(sq); r=chess.square_rank(sq)
        # centralization for pieces, advancement for pawns
        if p.piece_type==chess.PAWN:
            v += (r if p.color else 7-r)*5
            v += 8 if 2<=f<=5 else 0
        elif p.piece_type==chess.KNIGHT:
            v += 12-(abs(f-3.5)+abs(r-3.5))*8
        elif p.piece_type==chess.BISHOP:
            v += 8-(abs(f-3.5)+abs(r-3.5))*3
        elif p.piece_type==chess.QUEEN:
            v += 4-(abs(f-3.5)+abs(r-3.5))*2
        elif p.piece_type==chess.KING:
            # reward castled-ish positions, penalize center early
            v += 20 if (p.color and r<=1) or ((not p.color) and r>=6) else 0
        s += v if p.color else -v
    return s
def stm_eval(b): return white_eval(b) if b.turn else -white_eval(b)
nodes=0
def neg(b,d,a,bt):
    global nodes; nodes+=1
    if d==0: return stm_eval(b)
    if b.is_checkmate(): return -100000
    if b.is_stalemate(): return 0
    ms=list(b.legal_moves)
    def key(m):
        s=0
        if b.is_capture(m):
            p=b.piece_at(m.to_square)
            if p:s+=10*VAL[p.symbol().upper()]
        if m.promotion:s+=900
        if b.gives_check(m):s+=80
        return s
    ms.sort(key=key,reverse=True)
    best=-999999
    for m in ms:
        b.push(m); v=-neg(b,d-1,-bt,-a); b.pop()
        if v>best:best=v
        if best>a:a=best
        if a>=bt:break
    return best
# Force root Qh5
m=chess.Move.from_uci('d1h5'); board.push(m)
start=time.time()
score=-neg(board,4,-999999,999999)
print('Qh5 score for white',score,'nodes',nodes,'time',time.time()-start)
# extract PV for 5 plies by choosing best at each node according to search
b=board.copy(); depth=4; pv=['Qh5']
while depth>0 and not b.is_game_over():
    bestv=-999999; bestm=None
    ms=list(b.legal_moves)
    # order same
    ms.sort(key=lambda m:(b.is_capture(m), b.gives_check(m)), reverse=True)
    for mm in ms:
        b.push(mm); v=-neg(b,depth-1,-999999,999999); b.pop()
        if v>bestv:bestv=v;bestm=mm
    pv.append(bestm.uci()); b.push(bestm); depth-=1
    print('pv so far',pv,'white eval',white_eval(b))
print('final fen',b.fen())
"}

def white_eval(b):
    if b.is_checkmate(): return -100000 if b.turn else 100000
    if b.is_stalemate() or b.is_insufficient_material(): return 0
    s=0
    for sq,p in b.piece_map().items():
        v=VAL[p.symbol().upper()]+PST[p.piece_type][sq if p.color else chess.square_mirror(sq)]
        s += v if p.color else -v
    if len(b.pieces(chess.BISHOP,True))>=2: s+=25
    if len(b.pieces(chess.BISHOP,False))>=2: s-=25
    return s
def stm_eval(b): return white_eval(b) if b.turn else -white_eval(b)
nodes=0
def qsearch(b,a,bt):
    global nodes;nodes+=1
    if b.is_checkmate():return -100000
    stand=stm_eval(b)
    if stand>=bt:return bt
    if stand>a:a=stand
    ms=[m for m in b.legal_moves if b.is_capture(m) or m.promotion]
    def key(m):
        s=0
        if b.is_capture(m):
            vic=b.piece_at(m.to_square);att=b.piece_at(m.from_square)
            if vic and att:s+=10*VAL[vic.symbol().upper()]-VAL[att.symbol().upper()]
        if m.promotion:s+=900
        return s
    ms.sort(key=key,reverse=True)
    for m in ms:

        if v>=bt:return bt
        if v>a:a=v
    return a
def neg(b,d,a,bt):

VAL={'P':100,'N':320,'B':330,'R':500,'Q':900,'K':0}
# simpler but sensible PST: use only knight/bishop center and pawn advancement
def white_eval(b):
    if b.is_checkmate(): return -100000 if b.turn else 100000
    if b.is_stalemate() or b.is_insufficient_material(): return 0
    s=0
    for sq,p in b.piece_map().items():
        v=VAL[p.symbol().upper()]
        f=chess.square_file(sq); r=chess.square_rank(sq)
        # centralization for pieces, advancement for pawns
        if p.piece_type==chess.PAWN:
            v += (r if p.color else 7-r)*5
            v += 8 if 2<=f<=5 else 0
        elif p.piece_type==chess.KNIGHT:
            v += 12-(abs(f-3.5)+abs(r-3.5))*8
        elif p.piece_type==chess.BISHOP:
            v += 8-(abs(f-3.5)+abs(r-3.5))*3
        elif p.piece_type==chess.QUEEN:
            v += 4-(abs(f-3.5)+abs(r-3.5))*2
        elif p.piece_type==chess.KING:
            # reward castled-ish positions, penalize center early
            v += 20 if (p.color and r<=1) or ((not p.color) and r>=6) else 0
        s += v if p.color else -v
    return s
def stm_eval(b): return white_eval(b) if b.turn else -white_eval(b)
nodes=0
def neg(b,d,a,bt):
    global nodes; nodes+=1
    if d==0: return stm_eval(b)
    if b.is_checkmate(): return -100000
    if b.is_stalemate(): return 0
    ms=list(b.legal_moves)
    def key(m):
        s=0
        if b.is_capture(m):
            p=b.piece_at(m.to_square)
            if p:s+=10*VAL[p.symbol().upper()]
        if m.promotion:s+=900
        if b.gives_check(m):s+=80
        return s
    ms.sort(key=key,reverse=True)
    best=-999999
    for m in ms:
        b.push(m); v=-neg(b,d-1,-bt,-a); b.pop()
        if v>best:best=v
        if best>a:a=best
        if a>=bt:break
    return best
# Force root Qh5
m=chess.Move.from_uci('d1h5'); board.push(m)
start=time.time()
score=-neg(board,4,-999999,999999)
print('Qh5 score for white',score,'nodes',nodes,'time',time.time()-start)
# extract PV for 5 plies by choosing best at each node according to search
b=board.copy(); depth=4; pv=['Qh5']
while depth>0 and not b.is_game_over():

    ms=list(b.legal_moves)
    # order same

print('final fen',b.fen())

{"code": "import chess, time
board=chess.Board('rnb1kbnr/ppp2ppp/8/4N3/3qp3/2N5/PPPP1PPP/R1BQKB1R w KQkq - 2 5')
VAL={'P':100,'N':320,'B':330,'R':500,'Q':900,'K':0}
# simpler but sensible PST: use only knight/bishop center and pawn advancement
def white_eval(b):
    if b.is_checkmate(): return -100000 if b.turn else 100000
    if b.is_stalemate() or b.is_insufficient_material(): return 0
    s=0
    for sq,p in b.piece_map().items():
        v=VAL[p.symbol().upper()]
        f=chess.square_file(sq); r=chess.square_rank(sq)
        # centralization for pieces, advancement for pawns
        if p.piece_type==chess.PAWN:
            v += (r if p.color else 7-r)*5
            v += 8 if 2<=f<=5 else 0
        elif p.piece_type==chess.KNIGHT:
            v += 12-(abs(f-3.5)+abs(r-3.5))*8
        elif p.piece_type==chess.BISHOP:
            v += 8-(abs(f-3.5)+abs(r-3.5))*3
        elif p.piece_type==chess.QUEEN:
            v += 4-(abs(f-3.5)+abs(r-3.5))*2
        elif p.piece_type==chess.KING:
            # reward castled-ish positions, penalize center early
            v += 20 if (p.color and r<=1) or ((not p.color) and r>=6) else 0
        s += v if p.color else -v
    return s
def stm_eval(b): return white_eval(b) if b.turn else -white_eval(b)
nodes=0
def neg(b,d,a,bt):
    global nodes; nodes+=1
    if d==0: return stm_eval(b)
    if b.is_checkmate(): return -100000
    if b.is_stalemate(): return 0
    ms=list(b.legal_moves)
    def key(m):
        s=0
        if b.is_capture(m):
            p=b.piece_at(m.to_square)
            if p:s+=10*VAL[p.symbol().upper()]
        if m.promotion:s+=900
        if b.gives_check(m):s+=80
        return s
    ms.sort(key=key,reverse=True)
    best=-999999
    for m in ms:
        b.push(m); v=-neg(b,d-1,-bt,-a); b.pop()
        if v>best:best=v
        if best>a:a=best
        if a>=bt:break
    return best
# Force root Qh5
m=chess.Move.from_uci('d1h5'); board.push(m)
start=time.time()
score=-neg(board,4,-999999,999999)
print('Qh5 score for white',score,'nodes',nodes,'time',time.time()-start)
# extract PV for 5 plies by choosing best at each node according to search
b=board.copy(); depth=4; pv=['Qh5']
while depth>0 and not b.is_game_over():
    bestv=-999999; bestm=None
    ms=list(b.legal_moves)
    # order same
    ms.sort(key=lambda m:(b.is_capture(m), b.gives_check(m)), reverse=True)
    for mm in ms:
        b.push(mm); v=-neg(b,depth-1,-999999,999999); b.pop()
        if v>bestv:bestv=v;bestm=mm
    pv.append(bestm.uci()); b.push(bestm); depth-=1
    print('pv so far',pv,'white eval',white_eval(b))
print('final fen',b.fen())
"}

        if v>best:best=v
        if best>a:a=best
        if a>=bt:break
    return best

    if b.is_stalemate() or b.is_insufficient_material(): return 0
    s=0
    for sq,p in b.piece_map().items():
        v=VAL[p.symbol().upper()]+PST[p.piece_type][sq if p.color else chess.square_mirror(sq)]
        s += v if p.color else -v
    if len(b.pieces(chess.BISHOP,True))>=2: s+=25
    if len(b.pieces(chess.BISHOP,False))>=2: s-=25
    return s

def qsearch(b,a,bt):

    if b.is_checkmate():return -100000

    ms=[m for m in b.legal_moves if b.is_capture(m) or m.promotion]
    def key(m):

VAL={'P':100,'N':320,'B':330,'R':500,'Q':900,'K':0}
# simpler but sensible PST: use only knight/bishop center and pawn advancement
def white_eval(b):
    if b.is_checkmate(): return -100000 if b.turn else 100000
    if b.is_stalemate() or b.is_insufficient_material(): return 0
    s=0
    for sq,p in b.piece_map().items():
        v=VAL[p.symbol().upper()]
        f=chess.square_file(sq); r=chess.square_rank(sq)
        # centralization for pieces, advancement for pawns
        if p.piece_type==chess.PAWN:
            v += (r if p.color else 7-r)*5
            v += 8 if 2<=f<=5 else 0
        elif p.piece_type==chess.KNIGHT:
            v += 12-(abs(f-3.5)+abs(r-3.5))*8
        elif p.piece_type==chess.BISHOP:
            v += 8-(abs(f-3.5)+abs(r-3.5))*3
        elif p.piece_type==chess.QUEEN:
            v += 4-(abs(f-3.5)+abs(r-3.5))*2
        elif p.piece_type==chess.KING:
            # reward castled-ish positions, penalize center early
            v += 20 if (p.color and r<=1) or ((not p.color) and r>=6) else 0
        s += v if p.color else -v
    return s
def stm_eval(b): return white_eval(b) if b.turn else -white_eval(b)
nodes=0
def neg(b,d,a,bt):
    global nodes; nodes+=1
    if d==0: return stm_eval(b)
    if b.is_checkmate(): return -100000
    if b.is_stalemate(): return 0
    ms=list(b.legal_moves)
    def key(m):
        s=0
        if b.is_capture(m):
            p=b.piece_at(m.to_square)
            if p:s+=10*VAL[p.symbol().upper()]
        if m.promotion:s+=900
        if b.gives_check(m):s+=80
        return s
    ms.sort(key=key,reverse=True)
    best=-999999
    for m in ms:
        b.push(m); v=-neg(b,d-1,-bt,-a); b.pop()
        if v>best:best=v
        if best>a:a=best
        if a>=bt:break
    return best
# Force root Qh5
m=chess.Move.from_uci('d1h5'); board.push(m)
start=time.time()
score=-neg(board,4,-999999,999999)
print('Qh5 score for white',score,'nodes',nodes,'time',time.time()-start)
# extract PV for 5 plies by choosing best at each node according to search
b=board.copy(); depth=4; pv=['Qh5']
while depth>0 and not b.is_game_over():

    ms=list(b.legal_moves)
    # order same

print('final fen',b.fen())

def negamax(b,depth,alpha,beta):

def white_eval(b):

    if b.is_stalemate() or b.is_insufficient_material(): return 0
    s=0
    for sq,p in b.piece_map().items():

        s += v if p.color else -v
    if len(b.pieces(chess.BISHOP,True))>=2: s+=25

    return s

def qsearch(b,a,bt):

    if b.is_checkmate():return -100000

    ms=[m for m in b.legal_moves if b.is_capture(m) or m.promotion]
    def key(m):

def white_eval(b):
    if b.is_checkmate(): return -100000 if b.turn else 100000
    if b.is_stalemate() or b.is_insufficient_material(): return 0
    s=0
    for sq,p in b.piece_map().items():
        v=VAL[p.symbol().upper()]+PST[p.piece_type][sq if p.color else chess.square_mirror(sq)]
        s += v if p.color else -v
    if len(b.pieces(chess.BISHOP,True))>=2: s+=25
    if len(b.pieces(chess.BISHOP,False))>=2: s-=25
    return s
def stm_eval(b): return white_eval(b) if b.turn else -white_eval(b)
nodes=0
def qsearch(b,a,bt):
    global nodes;nodes+=1
    if b.is_checkmate():return -100000
    stand=stm_eval(b)
    if stand>=bt:return bt
    if stand>a:a=stand
    ms=[m for m in b.legal_moves if b.is_capture(m) or m.promotion]
    def key(m):
        s=0
        if b.is_capture(m):
            vic=b.piece_at(m.to_square);att=b.piece_at(m.from_square)
            if vic and att:s+=10*VAL[vic.symbol().upper()]-VAL[att.symbol().upper()]
        if m.promotion:s+=900
        return s
    ms.sort(key=key,reverse=True)
    for m in ms:

        if v>=bt:return bt
        if v>a:a=v
    return a
def neg(b,d,a,bt):
